speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It is a message from the stairhead to the window, and nobody has to walk. String, spool, a bucket-handle, two of Aunt Joan's bobbins, and a weight.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: It has been sent three times. It has arrived none times. That is a very clear machine.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Three sends and no arrival is an arithmetic, Hamnet, not a tragedy. Show him, and then argue.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The weight is essential. Without it the string has opinions.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The weight has hit the same board three times. I think the board has understood.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In London I should tell it thus. A boy builds a post for his words, and the post refuses the office, and his sister—

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: It'll sound different when we're not there to answer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not use it. Not in London, and not on a stage, and not to make any of you the person who was not in the room to say you were mis-told. I mean that.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Good. The linen is clean, and the joke can stay in this chamber, where it can be answered. I was waiting to hear whether the objection would become a second tale. It will not.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Then may we mend it, if it is not to be a story?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mend it. I am only the floor it is being mended above.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I can't read his string, but I can see the knot. The knot is in the place he likes, which is the wrong place.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Let her move one thing. If it still fails, the fault is the design and not the sister.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: She may move anything that is not the weight. The weight is the engine.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: You said no one was to touch the weight. I have not touched the weight. I am thinking about it, which is not touching.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Thinking is allowed. I want this linen on the chest, and I want no spool in the washing. Two bobbins came off my wheel. I want two bobbins back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two bobbins, one weight, three failures. That is the whole sum. It is funnier with you in the room than it will ever be without you, which is what your sister has just said, and she is right.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Then leave it here. We will have it work by dinner, or we will have a truer argument than a post that will not go.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: It will work by dinner. I have intended the method since the second failure. The third was a test of the weight.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The third was a knot. Come. Father is laughing with his mouth shut, and it hurts him, so the rest is for the landing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go on. I'll hear the spool if it ever reaches the window. I will not help it become a tale.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: And you will not tell it while we are on the stair, either. A failure is not a gift you may carry downstairs.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The chest, then the landing. I am not carrying linen as a witness for a spool.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Two bobbins. Both of them back before supper, Aunt Joan. I am not a thief of wheels. I am a borrower.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Both, before supper, and the weight stays in this chamber. I am not lending a wheel to a story.
